Please tell me wearing silver ring with nilam stone allowed in Islam? If yes then how many carat for me.what benefits for me?my brith date is 16-12-1964. is it nilam stone for me? give full detail. thanks Answer ID: 29135 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim !
